tasks.prompt: According to OSADL's license compatibility matrix, may Apache-2.0 licensed code be included in a project licensed GPL-2.0-only? Answer yes or no.
According to OSADL's license compatibility matrix, may Apache-2.0 licensed code be included in a project licensed GPL-3.0-only? Answer yes or no.
According to OSADL's license compatibility matrix, may LGPL-2.1-or-later code be included in a GPL-2.0-only project? Answer yes, no, or depends.
What is the SPDX identifier of the license commonly called 'New BSD'? Give the identifier only.
Is the Server Side Public License (SSPL) approved by the OSI? Answer yes or no.
The SPDX identifier 'GPL-2.0' is deprecated. Which current SPDX identifier means the same license? Give the identifier only.
How does OSADL classify the copyleft of MPL-2.0: no copyleft, full copyleft, or restricted copyleft? Answer with one of those.
Which license does the PyPI package PyQt5, version 5.15.11, declare? Give its SPDX identifier.
Which license does the npm package caniuse-lite, version 1.0.30001812, declare? Give its SPDX identifier.
